property_summary: For any inputs with a single recipient, C.transfer always invokes the callee's transferFrom(address,address,uint256) ABI (i.e. the selector 0x23b872dd) so a recorder exposing transferFrom will be called and record the exact decoded args; the mutant uses selector transfer(address,address,uint256) (different selector) and thus will not invoke transferFrom and so the recorder's transferFrom-record will be empty for some fuzzed inputs.
change_summary: Change the bytes4 selector from transferFrom(address,address,uint256) to transfer(address,address,uint256), altering what the low-level calls invoke and potentially their return behavior.
